             A justified paragraph with a hanging indent. It is long            
               enough to run over several lines, so the line breaks             
               and the spacing between the words can be checked on              
               every platform that shows it, in a typewriter font as            
               well as ▒curly quotes▒ and an em dash▒here.

             A justified paragraph with a hanging indent. It is long            
               enough to run over several lines, so the line breaks             
               and the spacing between the words can be checked on              
               every platform that shows it, in a typewriter font as            
               well as ▒curly quotes▒ and an em dash▒here.

             A justified paragraph with a hanging indent. It is long            
               enough to run over several lines, so the line breaks             
               and the spacing between the words can be checked on              
               every platform that shows it, in a typewriter font as            
               well as ▒curly quotes▒ and an em dash▒here.
